description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_AddAutoloadFilters, which extends another class and provides a method to add autoload filters within the Smarty templating engine. It handles different filter types and merges filters into existing autoload filter arrays.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_AddAutoloadFilters
classes.description: A class responsible for adding autoload filters to Smarty's configuration, extending the functionality of setting autoload filters.

methods.name: addAutoloadFilters
methods.description: Adds specified filters to Smarty's autoload filter configuration, merging with existing filters of the same type or creating new entries if none exist.
